Natural Health Trends Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

 

  – Company successfully held its 25th anniversary celebration in Hong Kong in August
  – Active Member count up, revenue steady with prior quarter
  – Operating loss narrowed 57% compared to prior quarter
  – Board of Directors authorized additional stock repurchases, with $15.8 million available  

 

LOS ANGELES – October 28, 2026 – Natural Health Trends Corp. (NASDAQ: NHTC), a leading direct-selling and e-commerce company that markets premium quality personal care, wellness and “quality of life” products under the NHT Global brand, today announced its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

 

Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

 

 

•

Revenue of $7.6 million was steady compared to the $7.6 million in the second quarter of 2026 and declined 20% compared to $9.5 million in the third quarter of 2025.

 

 

•

Operating loss was $277,000 compared to $643,000 in the second quarter of 2026 and $495,000 in the third quarter of 2025.

 

 

•

Net loss was $232,000, or $0.03 per diluted share, compared to $451,000, or $0.05 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026 and $431,000, or $0.04 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025. 

 

 

•

The number of Active Members1 was 27,040 at September 30, 2026 compared to 26,000 at June 30, 2026, 26,650 at December 31, 2025 and 28,030 at September 30, 2025.

 

 

1

Natural Health Trends defines Active Members as those that have placed at least one product order with the Company during the preceding twelve-month period.

 

Year-to-Date 2026 Financial Results

 

 

•

Revenue of $24.4 million decreased 19% compared to $30.0 million in the first nine months of 2025.

 

 

•

Operating loss was $1.4 million compared to $1.2 million in the first nine months of 2025.

 

 

•

Net loss was $837,000, or $0.09 per diluted share, compared to $294,000, or $0.03 per diluted share, in the first nine months of 2025.

 

Management Commentary

 

“Consumer pessimism in our largest market, regulatory uncertainty and previously reported member code of conduct matters continued to weigh on purchasing and member activity. In response, we introduced additional incentives and lower-priced packages, which accounted for most of the year-on-year revenue decline but made our products more accessible and helped support a sequential increase in our Active Member count and steady the top line at the end of the third quarter,” commented Chris Sharng, President of Natural Health Trends Corp

 

Mr. Sharng continued, “Our 25th anniversary celebration brought together 1,000 attendees from around the world, sharing our vision for the future and building confidence in our business and products. We also launched a new AI-powered marketing and communication app and hosted follow-up appreciation events in three key markets. We continued our restructuring efforts to protect margins and reduce costs, contributing to a 57% reduction in operating loss compared with the preceding quarter. While conditions are still challenging, we remain focused on supporting our members.”

 

1
 

 

Balance Sheet and Cash Flow

 

 

•

Net cash used in operating activities was $3.3 million in the first nine months of 2026 compared to $5.0 million in the first nine months of 2025.
 

•

Total cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities were $17.6 million at September 30, 2026, down from $28.9 million at December 31, 2025 primarily due to the repurchase of shares of common stock and dividends paid during the first nine months of 2026, as well as cash used in operations.
  • The Company repurchased 28,022 shares of its common stock on the open market for an aggregate purchase price of $27,000 during the third quarter of 2026 and an additional 57,269 shares for an aggregate purchase price of $56,000 in October 2026. The Company’s Board of Directors has since authorized additional share repurchases under its existing stock repurchase program, subject to market conditions and other relevant considerations.

About Natural Health Trends Corp.

 

Natural Health Trends Corp. (NASDAQ: NHTC) is an international direct-selling and e-commerce company operating through its subsidiaries throughout Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The Company markets premium quality personal care products under the NHT Global brand. Additional information can be found on the Company’s website at www.naturalhealthtrendscorp.com.
